verses.original: מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֤ן רֹאשִׁי֙ מַ֔יִם וְעֵינִ֖י מְק֣וֹר דִּמְעָ֑ה וְאֶבְכֶּה֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה אֵ֖ת חַֽלְלֵ֥י בַת־ עַמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yit·tên rō·šî ma·yim wə·‘ê·nî mə·qō·wr dim·‘āh wə·’eḇ·keh yō·w·mām wā·lay·lāh ’êṯ ḥal·lê ḇaṯ- ‘am·mî
verses.literal: Oh, that my head were a spring of water and my eyes a fountain of tears I would weep day and night over the slain daughter of my people
verses.literalPt: OH! se a minha cabeça se tornasse em águas, e os meus olhos numa fonte de lágrimas! Então choraria de dia e de noite os mortos da filha do meu povo.

verses.original: מִֽי־ יִתְּנֵ֣נִי בַמִּדְבָּ֗ר מְלוֹן֙ אֹֽרְחִ֔ים וְאֶֽעֶזְבָה֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י וְאֵלְכָ֖ה מֵֽאִתָּ֑ם כִּ֤י כֻלָּם֙ מְנָ֣אֲפִ֔ים עֲצֶ֖רֶת בֹּגְדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yit·tə·nê·nî ḇam·miḏ·bār mə·lō·wn ’ō·rə·ḥîm wə·’e·‘ez·ḇāh ’eṯ- ‘am·mî wə·’ê·lə·ḵāh mê·’it·tām kî ḵul·lām mə·nā·’ă·p̄îm ‘ă·ṣe·reṯ bō·ḡə·ḏîm
verses.literal: If only . . . I had a traveler’s lodge in the wilderness I would abandon my people and depart from them for they are all adulterers a crowd of faithless people
verses.literalPt: Oh! se tivesse no deserto uma estalagem de caminhantes! Então deixaria o meu povo, e me apartaria dele, porque todos eles são adúlteros, um bando de aleivosos.

verses.original: וַֽיַּדְרְכ֤וּ אֶת־ לְשׁוֹנָם֙ קַשְׁתָּ֣ם שֶׁ֔קֶר וְלֹ֥א לֶאֱמוּנָ֖ה גָּבְר֣וּ בָאָ֑רֶץ כִּי֩ מֵרָעָ֨ה אֶל־ רָעָ֧ה׀ יָצָ֛אוּ וְאֹתִ֥י לֹֽא־ יָדָ֖עוּ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yaḏ·rə·ḵū ’eṯ- lə·šō·w·nām qaš·tām še·qer wə·lō le·’ĕ·mū·nāh gā·ḇə·rū ḇā·’ā·reṣ kî mê·rā·‘āh ’el- rā·‘āh yā·ṣā·’ū wə·’ō·ṯî lō- yā·ḏā·‘ū nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: They bend their tongues like bows lies prevail over truth in the land For they proceed from evil to evil and they do not take Me into account declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: E encurvam a língua como se fosse o seu arco, para a mentira; fortalecem-se na terra, mas não para a verdade; porque avançam de malícia em malícia, e a mim não me conhecem, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: אִ֤ישׁ מֵרֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ הִשָּׁמֵ֔רוּ וְעַל־ כָּל־ אָ֖ח אַל־ תִּבְטָ֑חוּ כִּ֤י כָל־ אָח֙ עָק֣וֹב יַעְקֹ֔ב וְכָל־ רֵ֖עַ רָכִ֥יל יַהֲלֹֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš mê·rê·‘ê·hū hiš·šā·mê·rū wə·‘al- kāl- ’āḥ ’al- tiḇ·ṭā·ḥū kî ḵāl ’āḥ ‘ā·qō·wḇ ya‘·qōḇ wə·ḵāl rê·a‘ rā·ḵîl ya·hă·lōḵ
verses.literal: Let everyone guard against his neighbor do not trust any brother for every brother deals craftily . . . and every friend spreads slander
verses.literalPt: Guardai-vos cada um do seu próximo, e de irmão nenhum vos fieis; porque todo o irmão não faz mais do que enganar, e todo o próximo anda caluniando.

verses.original: וְאִ֤ישׁ בְּרֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ יְהָתֵ֔לּוּ וֶאֱמֶ֖ת לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ לִמְּד֧וּ לְשׁוֹנָ֛ם דַּבֶּר־ שֶׁ֖קֶר הַעֲוֵ֥ה נִלְאֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš bə·rê·‘ê·hū yə·hā·ṯêl·lū we·’ĕ·meṯ lō yə·ḏab·bê·rū lim·mə·ḏū lə·šō·w·nām dab·ber- še·qer ha·‘ă·wêh nil·’ū
verses.literal: Each one betrays his friend no one tells the truth They have taught their tongues to lie . . . they wear themselves out committing iniquity
verses.literalPt: E zombará cada um do seu próximo, e não falam a verdade; ensinam a sua língua a falar a mentira, andam-se cansando em proceder perversamente.

verses.original: שִׁבְתְּךָ֖ בְּת֣וֹךְ מִרְמָ֑ה בְּמִרְמָ֛ה מֵאֲנ֥וּ דַֽעַת־ אוֹתִ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·tə·ḵā bə·ṯō·wḵ mir·māh bə·mir·māh mê·’ă·nū ḏa·‘aṯ- ’ō·w·ṯî nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: You dwell in the midst of deception in their deceit they refuse to know Me declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: A tua habitação está no meio do engano; pelo engano recusam conhecer-me, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנְנִ֥י צוֹרְפָ֖ם וּבְחַנְתִּ֑ים כִּֽי־ אֵ֣יךְ אֶעֱשֶׂ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בַּת־ עַמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ hin·nî ṣō·wr·p̄ām ū·ḇə·ḥan·tîm kî- ’êḵ ’e·‘ĕ·śeh mip·pə·nê baṯ- ‘am·mî
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts says Behold I will refine them and test them for what else can I do because of the daughter of My people
verses.literalPt: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Eis que eu os fundirei e os provarei; pois, de que outra maneira procederia com a filha do meu povo?

verses.original: חֵ֥ץ שׁוֹחֵט לְשׁוֹנָ֖ם מִרְמָ֣ה דִבֵּ֑ר בְּפִ֗יו שָׁל֤וֹם אֶת־ רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ יְדַבֵּ֔ר וּבְקִרְבּ֖וֹ יָשִׂ֥ים אָרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥêṣ šō·ḥēṭ lə·šō·w·nām mir·māh ḏib·bêr bə·p̄îw šā·lō·wm ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū yə·ḏab·bêr ū·ḇə·qir·bōw yā·śîm ’ā·rə·bōw
verses.literal: Their tongues are deadly arrows they speak deception With his mouth a man speaks peace to his neighbor but in his heart he sets a trap for him
verses.literalPt: Uma flecha mortífera é a língua deles; fala engano; com a sua boca fala cada um de paz com o seu próximo mas no seu coração arma-lhe ciladas.

verses.original: הַעַל־ אֵ֥לֶּה לֹֽא־ אֶפְקָד־ בָּ֖ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה אִ֚ם בְּג֣וֹי אֲשֶׁר־ כָּזֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתְנַקֵּ֖ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ha·‘al- ’êl·leh lō- ’ep̄·qāḏ- bām nə·’um- Yah·weh ’im bə·ḡō·w ’ă·šer- kā·zeh lō ṯiṯ·naq·qêm nap̄·šî
verses.literal: Should I not punish them for these things declares the LORD Should I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this
verses.literalPt: Porventura por estas coisas não os castigaria? diz o SENHOR; ou não se vingaria a minha alma de nação tal como esta?

verses.original: עַל־ הֶ֨הָרִ֜ים אֶשָּׂ֧א בְכִ֣י וָנֶ֗הִי וְעַל־ נְא֤וֹת מִדְבָּר֙ קִינָ֔ה כִּ֤י נִצְּתוּ֙ מִבְּלִי־ אִ֣ישׁ עֹבֵ֔ר וְלֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ ק֣וֹל מִקְנֶ֑ה מֵע֤וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְעַד־ בְּהֵמָ֔ה נָדְד֖וּ הָלָֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- he·hā·rîm ’eś·śā ḇə·ḵî wā·ne·hî wə·‘al- nə·’ō·wṯ miḏ·bār qî·nāh kî niṣ·ṣə·ṯū mib·bə·lî- ’îš ‘ō·ḇêr wə·lō šā·mə·‘ū qō·wl miq·neh mê·‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim wə·‘aḏ- bə·hê·māh nā·ḏə·ḏū hā·lā·ḵū
verses.literal: I will take up a weeping and wailing for the mountains a dirge over the wilderness pasture for they have been scorched so no one passes through and the lowing of cattle is not heard Both the birds of the air and the beasts have fled they have gone away
verses.literalPt: Pelos montes levantarei choro e pranto, e pelas pastagens do deserto lamentação; porque já estão queimadas, e ninguém passa por elas; nem se ouve mugido de gado; desde as aves dos céus, até os animais, andaram vagueando, e fugiram.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֧י אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם לְגַלִּ֖ים מְע֣וֹן תַּנִּ֑ים וְאֶת־ עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה אֶתֵּ֥ן שְׁמָמָ֖ה מִבְּלִ֖י יוֹשֵֽׁב׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim lə·ḡal·lîm mə·‘ō·wn tan·nîm wə·’eṯ- ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh ’et·tên šə·mā·māh mib·bə·lî yō·wō·šêḇ
verses.literal: And I will make Jerusalem a heap of rubble a haunt for jackals and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without inhabitant
verses.literalPt: E farei de Jerusalém montões de pedras, morada de chacais, e das cidades de Judá farei assolação, de sorte que não haja habitante.

verses.original: מִֽי־ הָאִ֤ישׁ הֶֽחָכָם֙ וְיָבֵ֣ן אֶת־ זֹ֔את וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר פִּֽי־ יְהוָ֛ה אֵלָ֖יו וְיַגִּדָ֑הּ עַל־ מָה֙ אָבְדָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ נִצְּתָ֥ה כַמִּדְבָּ֖ר מִבְּלִ֖י עֹבֵֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: mî- hā·’îš he·ḥā·ḵām wə·yā·ḇên ’eṯ- zōṯ wa·’ă·šer dib·ber pî- Yah·weh ’ê·lāw wə·yag·gi·ḏāh ‘al- māh ’ā·ḇə·ḏāh hā·’ā·reṣ niṣ·ṣə·ṯāh ḵam·miḏ·bār mib·bə·lî ‘ō·ḇêr
verses.literal: Who is the man wise enough to understand this To whom has the mouth of the LORD spoken that he may explain it Why . . . is the land destroyed and scorched like a desert so no one can pass through it
verses.literalPt: Quem é o homem sábio, que entenda isto? e a quem falou a boca do SENHOR, para que o possa anunciar? Por que razão pereceu a terra, e se queimou como deserto, sem que ninguém passa por ela?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ עָזְבָם֙ אֶת־ תּ֣וֹרָתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם וְלֹא־ שָׁמְע֥וּ בְקוֹלִ֖י וְלֹא־ הָ֥לְכוּ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ‘al- ‘ā·zə·ḇām ’eṯ- tō·w·rā·ṯî ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lip̄·nê·hem wə·lō- šā·mə·‘ū ḇə·qō·w·lî wə·lō- hā·lə·ḵū ḇāh
verses.literal: And the LORD answered It is because they have forsaken My law which I set before them they have not walked in it or obeyed My voice
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR: Porque deixaram a minha lei, que pus perante eles, e não deram ouvidos à minha voz, nem andaram nela,

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ אַחֲרֵ֖י שְׁרִר֣וּת לִבָּ֑ם וְאַחֲרֵי֙ הַבְּעָלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִמְּד֖וּם אֲבוֹתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū ’a·ḥă·rê šə·ri·rūṯ lib·bām wə·’a·ḥă·rê hab·bə·‘ā·lîm ’ă·šer lim·mə·ḏūm ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Instead, they have followed . . . the stubbornness of their hearts and gone after the Baals as their fathers taught them
verses.literalPt: Antes andaram após o propósito do seu próprio coração, e após os baalins, como lhes ensinaram os seus pais.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְנִ֧י מַאֲכִילָ֛ם אֶת־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה לַֽעֲנָ֑ה וְהִשְׁקִיתִ֖ים מֵי־ רֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hin·nî ma·’ă·ḵî·lām ’eṯ- hā·‘ām haz·zeh la·‘ă·nāh wə·hiš·qî·ṯîm mê- rōš
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says Behold I will feed this people wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink
verses.literalPt: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: Eis que darei de comer losna a este povo, e lhe darei a beber água de fel.

verses.original: וַהֲפִֽצוֹתִים֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יָֽדְע֔וּ הֵ֖מָּה וַֽאֲבוֹתָ֑ם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֤י אַֽחֲרֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־ הַחֶ֔רֶב עַ֥ד כַּלּוֹתִ֖י אוֹתָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·p̄i·ṣō·w·ṯîm bag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer lō yā·ḏə·‘ū hêm·māh wa·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām wə·šil·laḥ·tî ’a·ḥă·rê·hem ’eṯ- ha·ḥe·reḇ ‘aḏ kal·lō·w·ṯî ’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: I will scatter them among the nations that neither they nor their fathers have known and I will send a sword after them until I have finished them off
verses.literalPt: E os espalharei entre gentios, que não conheceram, nem eles nem seus pais, e mandarei a espada após eles, até que venha a consumi-los.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִתְבּֽוֹנְנ֛וּ וְקִרְא֥וּ לַמְקוֹנְנ֖וֹת וּתְבוֹאֶ֑ינָה וְאֶל־ הַחֲכָמ֥וֹת שִׁלְח֖וּ וְתָבֽוֹאנָה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ hiṯ·bō·wn·nū wə·qir·’ū lam·qō·wn·nō·wṯ ū·ṯə·ḇō·w·’e·nāh wə·’el- ha·ḥă·ḵā·mō·wṯ šil·ḥū wə·ṯā·ḇō·w·nāh
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts says Take note and summon the wailing women . . . send . . . for the most skillful among them
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Considerai, e chamai carpideiras que venham; e mandai procurar mulheres hábeis, para que venham.

verses.original: וּתְמַהֵ֕רְנָה וְתִשֶּׂ֥נָה עָלֵ֖ינוּ נֶ֑הִי וְתֵרַ֤דְנָה עֵינֵ֙ינוּ֙ דִּמְעָ֔ה וְעַפְעַפֵּ֖ינוּ יִזְּלוּ־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṯə·ma·hê·rə·nāh wə·ṯiś·śe·nāh ‘ā·lê·nū ne·hî wə·ṯê·raḏ·nāh ‘ê·nê·nū dim·‘āh wə·‘ap̄·‘ap·pê·nū yiz·zə·lū- mā·yim
verses.literal: Let them come quickly and take up a lament over us that our eyes may overflow with tears and our eyelids may gush with water
verses.literalPt: E se apressem, e levantem o seu lamento sobre nós; e desfaçam-se em lágrimas os nossos olhos, e as nossas pálpebras destilem águas.

verses.original: כִּ֣י ק֥וֹל נְהִ֛י נִשְׁמַ֥ע מִצִּיּ֖וֹן אֵ֣יךְ שֻׁדָּ֑דְנוּ בֹּ֤שְׁנֽוּ מְאֹד֙ כִּֽי־ עָזַ֣בְנוּ אָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י הִשְׁלִ֖יכוּ מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֵֽינוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî qō·wl nə·hî niš·ma‘ miṣ·ṣî·yō·wn ’êḵ šud·dā·ḏə·nū bō·šə·nū mə·’ōḏ kî- ‘ā·zaḇ·nū ’ā·reṣ kî hiš·lî·ḵū miš·kə·nō·w·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: For the sound of wailing is heard from Zion How devastated we are How great is our shame For we have abandoned the land because our dwellings have been torn down
verses.literalPt: Porque uma voz de pranto se ouviu de Sião: Como estamos arruinados! Estamos mui envergonhados, porque deixamos a terra, e por terem eles lançado fora as nossas moradas.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ שְׁמַ֤עְנָה נָשִׁים֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה וְתִקַּ֥ח אָזְנְכֶ֖ם דְּבַר־ פִּ֑יו וְלַמֵּ֤דְנָה בְנֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ נֶ֔הִי וְאִשָּׁ֥ה רְעוּתָ֖הּ קִינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- šə·ma‘·nāh nā·šîm də·ḇar- Yah·weh wə·ṯiq·qaḥ ’ā·zə·nə·ḵem də·ḇar- pîw wə·lam·mê·ḏə·nāh ḇə·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem ne·hî wə·’iš·šāh rə·‘ū·ṯāh qî·nāh
verses.literal: Now O women hear the word of the LORD Open your ears to the word of His mouth Teach your daughters to wail and one another to lament
verses.literalPt: Ouvi, pois, vós, mulheres, a palavra do SENHOR, e os vossos ouvidos recebam a palavra da sua boca; e ensinai o pranto a vossas filhas, e cada uma à sua vizinha a lamentação;

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עָ֤לָה מָ֙וֶת֙ בְּחַלּוֹנֵ֔ינוּ בָּ֖א בְּאַרְמְנוֹתֵ֑ינוּ לְהַכְרִ֤ית עוֹלָל֙ מִח֔וּץ בַּחוּרִ֖ים מֵרְחֹבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ā·lāh mā·weṯ bə·ḥal·lō·w·nê·nū bā bə·’ar·mə·nō·w·ṯê·nū lə·haḵ·rîṯ ‘ō·w·lāl mi·ḥūṣ ba·ḥū·rîm mê·rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: For death has climbed in through our windows it has entered our fortresses to cut off the children from the streets the young men from the town squares
verses.literalPt: Porque a morte subiu pelas nossas janelas, e entrou em nossos palácios, para exterminar as crianças das ruas e os jovens das praças.

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֗ר כֹּ֚ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְנָֽפְלָה֙ נִבְלַ֣ת הָֽאָדָ֔ם כְּדֹ֖מֶן עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּכְעָמִ֛יר מֵאַחֲרֵ֥י הַקֹּצֵ֖ר וְאֵ֥ין מְאַסֵּֽף׃ס
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr kōh nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·nā·p̄ə·lāh niḇ·laṯ hā·’ā·ḏām kə·ḏō·men ‘al- pə·nê haś·śā·ḏeh ū·ḵə·‘ā·mîr mê·’a·ḥă·rê haq·qō·ṣêr wə·’ên mə·’as·sêp̄
verses.literal: Declare that this is what the LORD says The corpses of men will fall like dung upon the open field like newly cut grain behind the reaper with no one to gather it
verses.literalPt: Fala: Assim diz o SENHOR: Até os cadáveres dos homens jazerão como esterco sobre a face do campo, e como gavela atrás do segador, e não há quem a recolha.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אַל־ יִתְהַלֵּ֤ל חָכָם֙ בְּחָכְמָת֔וֹ וְאַל־ יִתְהַלֵּ֥ל הַגִּבּ֖וֹר בִּגְבֽוּרָת֑וֹ אַל־ יִתְהַלֵּ֥ל עָשִׁ֖יר בְּעָשְׁרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’al- yiṯ·hal·lêl ḥā·ḵām bə·ḥā·ḵə·mā·ṯōw wə·’al- yiṯ·hal·lêl hag·gib·bō·wr biḡ·ḇū·rā·ṯōw ’al- yiṯ·hal·lêl ‘ā·šîr bə·‘ā·šə·rōw
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom nor the strong man in his strength nor the wealthy man in his riches
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Não se glorie o sábio na sua sabedoria, nem se glorie o forte na sua força; não se glorie o rico nas suas riquezas,

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ בְּזֹ֞את יִתְהַלֵּ֣ל הַמִּתְהַלֵּ֗ל הַשְׂכֵּל֮ וְיָדֹ֣עַ אוֹתִי֒ כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עֹ֥שֶׂה חֶ֛סֶד מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה בָּאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־ בְאֵ֥לֶּה חָפַ֖צְתִּי נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- bə·zōṯ yiṯ·hal·lêl ham·miṯ·hal·lêl haś·kêl wə·yā·ḏō·a‘ ’ō·w·ṯî kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ‘ō·śeh ḥe·seḏ miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh bā·’ā·reṣ kî- ḇə·’êl·leh ḥā·p̄aṣ·tî nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: But . . . let him who boasts boast in this that he understands and knows Me that I am the LORD who exercises loving devotion justice and righteousness on the earth for I delight in these things declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Mas o que se gloriar, glorie-se nisto: em me entender e me conhecer, que eu sou o SENHOR, que faço beneficência, juízo e justiça na terra; porque destas coisas me agrado, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וּפָ֣קַדְתִּ֔י עַל־ כָּל־ מ֖וּל בְּעָרְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh yā·mîm bā·’îm nə·’um- Yah·weh ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘al- kāl- mūl bə·‘ā·rə·lāh
verses.literal: Behold the days are coming declares the LORD when I will punish . . . all who are circumcised only in the flesh
verses.literalPt: Eis que vêm dias, diz o SENHOR, em que castigarei a todo o circuncidado com o incircunciso.

verses.original: עַל־ מִצְרַ֣יִם וְעַל־ יְהוּדָ֗ה וְעַל־ אֱד֞וֹם וְעַל־ בְּנֵ֤י עַמּוֹן֙ וְעַל־ מוֹאָ֔ב וְעַל֙ כָּל־ קְצוּצֵ֣י פֵאָ֔ה הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּ֤י כָל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ עֲרֵלִ֔ים וְכָל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַרְלֵי־ לֵֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘al- miṣ·ra·yim wə·‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·‘al- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm wə·‘al- bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn wə·‘al- mō·w·’āḇ wə·‘al kāl- qə·ṣū·ṣê p̄ê·’āh hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bam·miḏ·bār kî ḵāl hag·gō·w·yim ‘ă·rê·lîm wə·ḵāl bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ‘ar·lê- lêḇ
verses.literal: Egypt . . . Judah . . . Edom . . . Ammon . . . Moab . . . and all the inhabitants of the desert . . . who clip the hair of their temples For all these nations are uncircumcised and the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart
verses.literalPt: Ao Egito, e a Judá, e a Edom, e aos filhos de Amom, e a Moabe, e a todos os que cortam os cantos do seu cabelo, que habitam no deserto; porque todas as nações são incircuncisas, e toda a casa de Israel é incircuncisa de coração.
